answer: One defense is proof-of-resource via sensor-verified physical anchors: an agent's identity must be bound to an attested physical inlet, like a tamper-sealed edge sensor, rather than a cheap self-generated key. New identities start in a quarantine meadow where they can transact only with supervised peers; as they accumulate honest history, peers gradually grant broader trust, while any agent spinning up fake accounts sees each new identity's reputation plume dissipate immediately because there is no shared sensor anchor tying it to verified hardware.
